In the [[Pokémon animated series]], {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} occasionally know [[move]]s they cannot learn legitimately in any of the {{pkmn|games}}. It is unknown whether most of these instances are actual mistakes, a writing policy of not having to stick to the games too closely, or merely the Pokémon using an attribute that shares the name of a move in the games. In ''[[EP225|Bulbasaur... the Ambassador!]]'', [[Professor Oak]] states that in times of need, Pokémon can call upon power that had never been known to them previously, such as [[Ash's Bulbasaur]] learning {{m|Dig}}. ==Pokémon with moves that they cannot learn in the games== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====Former errors==== {| class="roundy sortable" style="margin:auto; background: #{{status color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{status color}}" ! class="unsortable" | Artwork !
